title: Mastering Anchor Tags (<a>)
ques: Explain the essential attributes of the **`<a>`** element: `href` protocols (`https://`, `mailto:`, `tel:`, `#id`), `target="_blank"`, and `download`.

answer.content:
Visit W3C Standards

Contact Support Email

Call Customer Service

Jump to Contact Section

Download Annual Report

explanation: Anchor tags create hyperlinks. The `href` attribute accepts web URLs, email links (`mailto:`), telephone links (`tel:`), page fragments (`#hash`), and file downloads (`download`).

title: Accessible Navigation Menus (<nav>)
ques: Build a semantic, accessible **Navigation Menu** using the `<nav>`, `<ul>`, and `<li>` elements, incorporating `aria-current="page"` for the active view.

answer.content:
• Home
  • Courses
  • About Us
  • Contact

explanation: Enclosing links inside `<nav>` and structured lists helps assistive technologies identify primary site navigation landmarks. `aria-current="page"` signals the current active view.
